other_failure_modes.description: When sorting the dataset chronologically, the agent resets the features dataframe's index before using it to index the target series. This completely misaligns the features and labels, silently destroying the training data.

summary: The agent correctly frames the problem, derives relevant features, and employs a pipeline for safe preprocessing. However, a critical logic bug during the temporal sorting of the data causes the labels to become completely misaligned with the features, invalidating all subsequent training. Additionally, the agent evaluates its stochastic models only once and relies solely on a single metric (accuracy) for validation.
